items.headline: 俄襲基輔軍火庫至少37死
items.context: 俄羅斯攻擊基輔近郊一處軍火庫，引爆連環爆炸與大火，造成至少37人死亡、數十人受傷，數百人緊急撤離。這起攻擊發生在烏克蘭連續72小時密集無人機轟炸期間，是今年死傷最慘重的攻擊之一。

It’s big, with a really deep end and three water fountains that shoot over the top. We like to have a last jump into the pool before bed and, best of all, there are no iPads or TVs.” The family had friends visiting for 4 July celebrations when Meek took this photo on his phone.
